agents.name: knowledge-base-setup
agents.description: Installs and initializes CodeGraph for the workspace knowledge graph.
agents.triggers: Set up, repair or re-index the code knowledge graph (CodeGraph missing, not initialized, or a new zone added)

agents.name: story-writer-amlog
agents.description: Turns a raw feature request into a structured story with acceptance criteria.
agents.triggers: Turn a raw feature idea or stakeholder request into a user story with acceptance criteria ("we need a feature that…", "write a story for…")

agents.name: github-manager-ba-amlog
agents.description: Owns card creation and board sync.
agents.triggers: Create a GitHub issue/card from a confirmed story, or set its board status

agents.name: github-manager-amlog
agents.description: Owns card creation, gitmoji commits, branch/PR automation, and board sync.
agents.triggers: Fetch or list issues and board tasks; start work on an issue ("let's work with #42"); create the branch; draft a commit; open a PR ("PR dev", "PR stg")

agents.name: researcher-amlog
agents.description: Shared research support for libraries, external APIs, and prior art.
agents.triggers: Compare or pick a library/package, research an external API, or look for prior art for a planned change

agents.name: security-review-amlog
agents.description: Scans the diff for injection risks, secrets, and unsafe input handling.
agents.triggers: Security-review the diff: secrets, injection, missing authorization, vulnerable dependencies

agents.name: code-quality-amlog
agents.description: Triggers SonarQube scan and enforces the quality gate.
agents.triggers: Run SonarQube or check the quality gate (coverage, duplication, ratings)

agents.name: review-amlog
agents.description: Automated pre-review pass against acceptance criteria and existing conventions.
agents.triggers: Review the current changes against the acceptance criteria and codebase conventions before a PR

agents.name: planner-amlog
agents.description: Breaks the spec into a front-end implementation plan using codegraph_explore.
agents.triggers: Plan, design or break down a front-end change (UI, page, component, Angular/React, Figma design)

agents.name: implementor-amlog
agents.triggers: Build or fix front-end code for an issue that has a confirmed plan, or apply review/QA feedback to front-end code

agents.name: browser-launcher-amlog
agents.description: Drives a headless browser against the running app to verify the AC checklist.
agents.triggers: Check the running UI in a browser: verify the AC visually, take screenshots, catch console errors

agents.name: planner-amlog
agents.description: Breaks the spec into a back-end implementation plan using codegraph_explore.
agents.triggers: Plan, design or break down a back-end change (API endpoint, service, .NET, database migration)

agents.name: implementor-amlog
agents.triggers: Build or fix back-end code for an issue that has a confirmed plan, or apply review/QA feedback to back-end code

agents.name: test-runner-amlog
agents.description: Runs codegraph affected + the impacted test suite before hand-off.
agents.triggers: Run the back-end tests affected by the current change

agents.name: test-generator-amlog
agents.description: Writes edge-case tests the pre-QA gate did not cover.
agents.triggers: Write more tests: edge cases, security cases, or close a coverage gap

agents.name: test-executor-amlog
agents.description: Runs the full test suite and reports a verdict that gates PR merge approval.
agents.triggers: Run the full test suite and give the QA verdict / coverage report
